_comment: Request body limits of the demo API, read by the API (utils/upload_limits.py) and by the Next proxy (lib/upload-limits.ts). A route is matched by its API path, or by a prefix ending in '/'. max_mb is the whole request in MiB, multipart fields included; max_files is the number of file parts one request may carry. A route not listed here takes the default, which carries no files. The largest max_mb must stay within proxyClientMaxBodySize in next.config.ts and proxy-body-size in openshift/route.yaml.
